purpose_not_supported: This file purpose is not supported. Upload it as user_data or vision.
invalid_file: The file was not accepted. Check its type and contents, then upload it again.
file_too_large: The file is larger than the size limit. Upload a smaller file.
file_not_found: This file was not found or you can't access it. Check the file ID.
file_expired: This file has expired and can no longer be used. Upload it again.
file_dereference_failed: The file could not be loaded from storage, so the request was not sent. Try again shortly.
file_storage_failed: File storage did not finish the operation. Try again shortly.
storage_not_configured: File storage is not set up on this site, so files can't be saved or read. Contact the administrator.
storage_quota_exceeded: Your file storage is full. Delete files you no longer need; files are also removed automatically 30 days after upload.
unsupported_media_kind: This media type is not supported. Choose image or video.
unsupported_media_status: This status filter is not supported. Use pending, running, succeeded or failed.
media_job_not_found: This media job was not found. Check the job ID.
artifact_file_not_found: The artifact file was not found. Check the file ID, or upload the file again.
video_not_found: This video job was not found. Check the job ID.
invalid_precreated_media_job: The media job named in this request does not match it. Start the generation again.
artifact_too_large: The generated file is larger than the size that can be stored, so the result was not kept. Try a smaller size or shorter duration.
video_artifact_missing: The video finished without a file to download. Generate it again.
search_backend_not_found: This search backend was not found. Refresh the list.
search_backend_provider_invalid: This search provider is not supported or does not match the channel type. Choose a listed provider.
upload_file_not_found: This data file was not found on the server. Check the file path.
upload_key_not_allowed: This path can't be uploaded. Directories and configuration files are excluded; choose a regular data file.
upload_failed: Object storage did not accept the upload. Check the storage settings and try again.
